tracks.title: 大帽山結霜啦
tracks.subject: the January night Hong Kong chased frost up Tai Mo Shan: minibus queues stretching down the street outside Tsuen Wan station, crowds walking the last half of the road wrapped in bedsheets, a stranger pouring hot tea from a flask, and a secondary-school boy at the summit filming ice growing along a fence wire while everyone around him goes quiet
